CustomField.description: The HubSpot object id to stamp. The write-back uses batch/update keyed on THIS id, never batch/upsert keyed on the sf-id property -- an upsert against a record whose sf-id is still blank would create a second HubSpot record. HubSpot ids are portal-scoped, which is why Portal__c is part of every row.
CustomField.label: HubSpot Id
